next.reason: Same prohibition: 1985 'must not refer directly or indirectly to any program that has been called and has not yet executed an EXIT PROGRAM'; 2023 'shall not be in the active state or contain a program in the active state' (§2023:14.9.5.4 GR5). 1985 states no result for a violation; 2023 raises EC-PROGRAM-CANCEL-ACTIVE when checking is enabled, 'and the referenced program is not canceled', otherwise the result is implementor-defined (§2023:14.9.5.4 GR5). A run-time rule in both editions; the violation now has a defined outcome.
